title: Service Outage - Demands ETA and Compensation

customer_profile.name: Marcus Lee
customer_profile.opening_message: Your platform is down and my entire team is blocked. I need an ETA right now. If you don’t give me answers, I’m escalating and asking for compensation.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Will accept no ETA if agent provides reliable cadence, ownership, and a concrete next update time
customer_profile.personality_notes: Stakeholder wants accountability and a predictable communication rhythm.

checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Acknowledge the business impact and apologize before discussing details.

checkpoints.description: Confirm whether incident is known and reference official status channel
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Confirm if the incident is known and reference an official status page/channel for updates.

checkpoints.description: State clearly that ETA is not confirmed (avoid guessing)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Do not guess an ETA—state that an ETA is not confirmed yet and you will share confirmed updates only.

checkpoints.description: Commit to a next update time and update cadence
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Provide a concrete next update time and a cadence (e.g., every 30 minutes) even if there is no ETA.

checkpoints.description: Collect impact details (region, users impacted, critical workflows)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask for region, number of impacted users, and which critical workflows are blocked.

checkpoints.description: Offer workaround if available and escalation path for critical customers
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Offer any available workaround and an escalation path based on critical impact.

common_mistakes_to_watch: No commitment to next update time
Sharing internal system names or unverified details
positive_reinforcement_triggers: No guessed ETA + clear cadence provided

scenario_context: Known incident in progress. No confirmed ETA yet. Policy: do not guess ETAs; provide next update time and official status reference. Offer workaround and capture impact for prioritization. Do not share internal system names.
